input.query: Can the Cedar helpdesk reset the portal password?

supplied.title: Cedar travel policy
supplied.text: Cedar employees may claim rail travel booked at least seven days ahead. This current rule replaces the former three-day booking window.

supplied.title: Cedar travel policy
supplied.text: Cedar claims above 500 fictional credits require an itemised receipt; the former rule used 300 credits.

supplied.title: Cedar travel policy
supplied.text: A current itinerary change needs the original booking reference within one working day; the former rule allowed two days.

supplied.title: Cedar travel policy

supplied.title: Cedar remote work A

supplied.title: Cedar remote work A
supplied.text: Two named weekdays must be recorded. Only a manager records the schedule.

supplied.title: Cedar remote work A
supplied.text: Only a manager approves an ordinary remote schedule. Only a security reviewer approves an emergency schedule change.

supplied.title: Cedar remote work B
supplied.text: Cedar employees may work remotely three days each week. This rule has equal authority to remote work A.

supplied.title: Cedar remote work B
supplied.text: Three named weekdays must be recorded. Only a security reviewer records the schedule.

supplied.title: Cedar remote work B
supplied.text: Only a team-calendar entry is accepted as the approval record before the first remote day; a manager email is not accepted.

supplied.title: Cedar remote work B
supplied.text: A manager or security reviewer may approve an ordinary remote schedule. Only a manager approves an emergency schedule change.
